title: Duas Bandeiras
summary: Players return from the Thanksgiving break and Adrian announces the two-game competitive focus to all divisions.
keyEvents: The five Kairos rosters resume training after the holiday break.
Adrian announces that League of Legends and Counter-Strike 2 are Kairos's active competitive projects.
VALORANT is cancelled; Dota 2 remains monitoring only.
Moss and Atlas reaffirm the February target; neither team has played an official match.
